hook: Sankranthi trains to AP sold out *two months* early
hook_b: Sankranthi trains to AP sold out *two months* early
tldr: Popular Secunderabad-Visakhapatnam and Godavari-district trains ran out of tickets minutes after 60-day advance booking opened for Jan 9-12.

beats.what: Godavari Superfast, Garib Rath, LTT Visakhapatnam and Visakha Express show REGRET in Sleeper; Gowthami, Cocanada and Narasapur are full or long-waitlisted, per TOI.
beats.why: Railways open reservations 60 days ahead, and demand for the Sankranthi weekend to AP is far above seats.
beats.care: If you are heading home for Sankranthi, confirmed train seats are already scarce and passengers fear bus fares will rise.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: SCR says it will run hundreds of special trains and may add coaches to existing services.

sources.title: Two-months ahead, train tickets to AP sold out for Sankranthi

fact: AP-bound Sankranthi trains from Hyderabad show *REGRET* nearly two months early.
twist: SCR runs *at least 100* trains between Telangana and AP, yet Jan 9-12 seats are gone; Mumbai, Delhi and Bengaluru trains still have berths.
